features.featureTitle: Fix the ReadinessScoreRing component so it is always visible on the Dashboard and Skill Gap pages. The ring must render the score percentage and SVG ring at all times — including when the user has no study plan (display 0%), when the query is loading (show a skeleton), and when a backend error occurs (fall back to 0% silently without showing an error message). Remove any error boundary or conditional rendering path that hides the ring or shows 'Something went wrong. Please try again.'

In `useQueries.ts`, update the `useGetReadinessScore` React Query hook so that any thrown error or rejected promise from the backend is caught and resolved as 0 rather than propagating to an error state. Set `retry: false` and use an `onError` or `select` handler to default to 0 on failure.
